nodes.speaker: Cornelius Vane
nodes.text: YOU. The statue vandal. Do you have ANY idea what that likeness cost? The sculptor wept when he finished it. Wept, sir!

choices.text: It's over, Vane. I have the ledger.

nodes.speaker: Cornelius Vane
nodes.text: Those begonias were imported! Everything here is imported! Including, apparently, CRIME.

nodes.speaker: Cornelius Vane
nodes.text: The— my LEDGER? That is a private diary of... philanthropic arithmetic!

nodes.speaker: Cole
nodes.text: Your ledger's leaving with me, Vane. Every deed you invented, in your own hand.

nodes.speaker: Cornelius Vane
nodes.text: Progress, dear boy, is simply my name moving across a map! You can't arrest a MAP!

choices.text: Also — your travelling gold. Every coin of it, back.
Marshal can arrest the fella holding the pen.

nodes.speaker: Cornelius Vane
nodes.text: You're... giving it BACK? Who RAISED you? This is deeply unsettling behaviour from a criminal!

nodes.speaker: Cornelius Vane
nodes.text: GUARDS! Guards! ...They're all watching the statue, aren't they. Everyone loves that statue. LOVED. Oh, this is a terrible party.

nodes.speaker: Cole
nodes.text: The Code raised me. Take it up with the Code.
